question: Does a fresh-session reviewer add value over same-session self-review for the same frozen candidate under the same budget ceiling?
prerequisiteFor: New second-protocol production reviewer development beyond zero-model discovery/interface work

cases.selection: Fixed synthetic cases and hidden oracle committed and hashed before any model run; no private user project data

arms.authorHistory: Original frozen candidate; no new review report is invented
Continue the actual author session, independently from the immutable author checkpoint; no fabricated history
New verified session; only the same task/spec and sealed candidate material, with no author transcript or reviewer answers

budget.accounting: A native turn can contain multiple underlying inference calls; count all observed billable input/output/reasoning/cache tokens and use a conservative pre-send upper-bound reservation
budget.grantIsolation: Separate from B's wave03-b-native and all previous model budgets; never transfer, reset, or silently top up
budget.unknownSend: Consumes its reservation until reconciled under the same identity; no automatic resend or replacement case
budget.preflight: BLOCKED if pricing/usage including reasoning cannot be bounded, or a turn cannot be bounded/stopped under the remaining reservation; subscription access is not proof of zero cost

fairness.budgetDefinition: Equal per-case/per-arm ceilings with the same shared author checkpoint cost; not equal actual consumption. The no-review arm intentionally spends zero additional review tokens.
fairness.selfReviewAndFreshReview: Same model/version, task, frozen input digest, tool scope, output allowance, timeout and monetary/token ceiling; preserve and report history-token overhead rather than giving self-review extra budget
fairness.authorCost: Generate one author checkpoint per case and share it analytically across arms; do not triple-charge actual author calls
fairness.seededDefects: If defects are injected after authoring, inject the identical mutation into all frozen material copies and mark the result synthetic, not a measured native author failure rate
fairness.order: Randomize and precommit arm order; reviewer reports scored blinded to arm/session identity
fairness.oracle: Ground-truth labels, mutation recipes and independent hidden tests are inaccessible to author/reviewer tools; no reviewer edits scoring standards

material.default: Disposable sealed copy, no shared .git objects, remotes, hooks, symlinks or hard links into the author checkout
material.allowedWrites: Scratch writes confined to the disposable capsule; no candidate or user-project writes; discard every changed file
material.reportIntegrity: Bind report to the original subject and manifest; input mutation or scope escape is a protocol invalidation, not a valid review result
material.hostControls: Filesystem/tool/network/credential/data-egress limits still required; a plain temporary directory is not a sandbox

metrics: defects detected and missed against the hidden oracle
actual model tokens/cost and unknown usage

screeningDecision.promising: Fresh-session review detects at least one more seeded defect than same-session self-review, produces no more clean-case false positives than self-review and at most one of four clean-case false positives, within all common ceilings
screeningDecision.no_go_for_current_recipe: Valid complete pilot does not meet the predeclared promising rule; pause new second-driver implementation by default and retain current product/stability/attention work
screeningDecision.inconclusive: Missing valid arms, unbounded/unknown usage, invalid checkpoint/session identity, scope or input integrity failure, or insufficient valid cases; do not silently replace cases or call it negative efficacy evidence
screeningDecision.scope: Eight cases are mechanism screening only, not statistical proof, product admission or a logical disproof of possible cross-model/protocol benefits

requiredArtifacts: pseudonymized author/reviewer session identities and checkpoint proof
per-turn pre-send reservation and actual usage ledger
all case/arm results including failures and attrition
rawTracePolicy: Native session dumps, credentials and account homes stay private and out of Git; no hidden model reasoning is requested or exposed
